about.meta_description: Discover the history of Hotel Atlas Day, our philosophy and our commitment to excellence and Moroccan hospitality.
about.story_intro: Nestled in the heart of the Moroccan High Atlas, Hotel Atlas Day is much more than just a place to stay. It's an invitation to discover the soul of authentic Morocco, where the mountains meet the sky.
about.story_p1: Opened in 2015, our 4-star establishment was designed to celebrate the cultural richness of the Azilal region while offering the modern comfort our travelers demand. Every stone, every architectural detail tells a story - that of a land shaped by centuries and inhabited by the Berber people.
about.story_p2: Located near the majestic UNESCO-listed M'Goun Geopark and just kilometers from the famous Ouzoud Waterfalls, we are the ideal starting point for exploring the natural treasures of the High Atlas. Our privileged location makes us a haven of peace for travelers seeking authenticity and escape.
about.mission_text: To offer an incomparable Moroccan hospitality experience, where luxury and tradition meet to create unforgettable memories. We are committed to preserving the exceptional environment that surrounds us and supporting local communities.
about.value_excellence_desc: We strive for excellence in every detail, from personalized service to the quality of our facilities.
about.value_authenticity_desc: We celebrate Berber cultural heritage and traditional Moroccan hospitality.
about.value_sustainability_desc: We are committed to preserving the natural environment and supporting local communities.
about.value_innovation_desc: We combine ancestral traditions and modern comfort for a unique experience.
about.team_text: Our passionate and dedicated team is the beating heart of Hotel Atlas Day. Trained to international standards while preserving the art of Moroccan hospitality, our staff are ready to make your stay exceptional.
